what: Performance plan step 8 measure-first: hand-removed fuel tick in a pure counting loop (docs/2026-10-27-STEPS-6-8-REMAINING.md section 8)
program: 200,000,000-iteration self tail-call countdown, two Int ops + compare per iteration, no allocation
source:
# tick bound probe: a pure counting loop, no allocation, no calls in the body
sumTo : unsafe Int -> Int -> Int .
sumTo i acc = if i == 0 then acc else sumTo (i - 1) (acc + i).
main = print "countdown = {sumTo 200000000 0}".
method: build's kept root .s edited by hand; tickonly keeps `mov x9, x28` (hart read) and drops the fuel-cell ops; notick drops both. Same runtime objects, cc flags and prelude unit as `fpr build`. 7 alternating triples after warmup, medians; fastest alongside.
note: upper bound: the loop body is 6 instructions, so the tick is a large share; loops with real work see proportionally less. The build config reads the hart as `mov x9, x28`; the TLV call seen in `fpr compile --target=a64mac` output is a different hart contract and was not measured.
